scope: Post-cleanup native workspace and local parent/popup WebView2 workloads only. No pauses or traces; native input makes a run ineligible. Zero tracked survivors, owned native bytes and browser processes after close are mandatory. Working set is informational, not summed across shared browser pages. Existing timing/allocation release baseline is unchanged.
rationale: Frozen before fresh validation. Prior bounded-reporting runs showed small collected-heap steps, stable private-byte windows and fixed GUI initialization. Native limits permit at most 128 KiB aggregate heap drift and 64 KiB late drift; browser permits 256 KiB total and 64 KiB late. Whole-process ceilings are regression tripwires for these small workloads, not application capacity promises. Handle late-growth limits deliberately flag the older browser +20 late-handle outlier; failures are not discarded or fitted away. No cache-size subtraction is allowed.
